title: Document the one search on p.apyr.us: exact-word hits, Title match and Related labels, status options, who sees pending and rejected
description: Every Papyrus feature epic ends with a p.apyr.us docs task (document-features-on-marketing-site). Cover: searching from the top bar goes straight to results; Title match results rank above Related ones and each says which kind it is in words; pending, accepted and rejected shown in words with status buttons; editors and admins see pending and rejected, public pages stay accepted-only; the word index and its one-time backfill (docs/reference-search.md#word-index).
